Clipper2 (C# source), vendored for the Sim (decision 0021)

Upstream:   https://github.com/AngusJohnson/Clipper2 (CSharp folder), Angus Johnson
Licence:    Boost Software License 1.0 (LICENSE.txt in this folder)
Version:    No release tag is recorded in the vendored source. The file headers are dated:
            Clipper.Core.cs 12 Dec 2025, Clipper.Triangulation.cs 13 Dec 2025 (BETA), Clipper.Offset.cs 11 Oct 2025,
            PooledList.cs and HashCode.cs 7 Oct 2025, Clipper.Engine.cs and others as in their headers.
            Pin = these files as they are. Upgrading is a deliberate task (decision 0021).
Defines:    USINGZ is not defined, so the Clipper2Lib namespace is used and Z is not carried.

Compatibility edits (every change made to a vendored file):
  1. Clipper.Offset.cs, Clipper.Triangulation.cs, PooledList.cs, HashCode.cs: added `#nullable enable` as the first
     line. Why: these files use `?` reference annotations without a nullable context, which gives warning CS8632
     in Sim.Tests (Nullable disabled) and would in Unity. The other Clipper files already had the directive.
     No code change.

No other edits. The files compile unmodified at LangVersion 9.0 (Sim.Tests.csproj). They use no UnityEngine
types, no System.Numerics, no Span/Unsafe/BitOperations. The Sim.asmdef (noEngineReferences: true) covers this
folder, so no separate asmdef is needed.

Only Sim code calls Clipper, through Assets/Sim/Geometry/PolygonBoolean.cs. No Clipper type appears in a public
Sim API.
